fields.acceptance: Unit tests run a fake classifier command for transient, real, garbage output and a failing command, and show the parsed verdict, with real assumed on anything but a clear transient; the daemon-settings testscript lists the setting with its default; a testscript whose command step fails (e.g. build-leaf-fails) runs with the classifier empty from Setup and records no classifier call, and a script that sets a fake classifier command sees its verdict used.
fields.statement: A machine-wide setting names the failure classifier command: it reads a failed step's output on stdin and prints whether the failure is transient or real with a one-line reason; the default runs Claude headless with Haiku, any LLM CLI can be configured, and empty turns classification off. The testscript Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go sets the classifier empty, so no test calls an agent or the network; scripts that test classification set a fake classifier command.
